propositions: An authenticated file_impact_scope: none assertion requires correctness verification to prevent false declarations from silencing drift protection.
The no-file-impact criterion must apply deterministically only when persisted scope is exactly 'none', routing via the existing applies_at mechanism with require_file_impact_scope: ['none'].

The criterion decision logic must validate whether a ticket declaring no repository-file impact actually requires repository-file changes, using LLM judgment on plan text and persisted no_file_impact_reason.
The declared no_file_impact_reason must round-trip through deterministic JSON serialization in the Pass-1 request to preserve escaping and Unicode stability.

External-only deliverables produce PASS; required source, configuration, test, or documentation changes produce advisory contradiction; insufficient evidence produces non-blocking coaching without blocking claim.
